content: The information provided about this product is not a guarantee of its safety, efficacy, or suitability for your use. This content does not constitute personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. It is essential to consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information regarding this product and your specific health requirements. Adding plans enables you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs within the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans allows you to make informed comparisons. The information above is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. Individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
